mainText: President Trump will meet with envoys of Lebanon and Israel at the White House for talks.
The European Union approved a 106 billion dollar loan package for Ukraine after Hungary withdrew its veto.
Warner Bros shareholders approve Paramount takeover valued at $111 billion.
EU leaders meet in Cyprus to discuss Iran and Ukraine.
The International Criminal Court blocked the release of former President Rodrigo Duterte of the Philippines and stated it can try him.
